column1: # THE DECLUTTER CHECK'S EXEMPTIONS AND CAPS - K321 (b), (e), (f), Code's recommendation on Elias's K320 (docs/RULINGS_2026-10-23.md, UI_V33_SPEC s7).
# ONE PLACE: read by Tools/declutter_scan.pl and by PoliSim.Testing.DeclutterRules (the film's judge) alike, so the two can never disagree about
# which capture is exempt or where a cap falls. INSTRUCTION, edited by hand when a ruling moves - never generated. A change here moves every
# film's verdict: regenerate docs/generated/DECLUTTER_BASELINE.tsv in the same commit.
# Columns, tab-separated: kind, pattern or name, scope or value, reason
#   exempt  a capture-stem GLOB (* any run, ? one character, [..] a class), matched against the whole stem; the first match decides
#           scope all  - no cap is read on the capture (setup, dense and dagger views: K320 (4), K321 (e))
#           scope rest - the at-rest caps are not read; the slip caps are (the pinned slips: K321 (e) and (f))
#   cap     a named cap and its value; the reason is the ruling's words
